title: Rate-Limiting and Request/Parameter Tampering Analysis Rules

rules.name: Missing brute-force and rate-limit protection
rules.description: Authentication or credential-verifying endpoint (/login, /signin, /token, /otp, /reset-password) lacks rate-limiting or throttling protection, permitting automated brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks.

rules.name: Client-side parameter and hidden field tampering
rules.description: Privilege, role, or financial fields are accepted directly from untrusted request data (form, cookies, JSON) without server-side validation or cryptographic signing, enabling client-side parameter tampering.
rules.remediation_example: price = Product.query.get(product_id).price  # lookup authoritative price server-side; do not trust client form price

rules.name: HTTP verb tampering and method override
rules.description: Request handler trusts HTTP method override headers (X-HTTP-Method-Override, X-Method-Override) or binds state-changing actions to both safe (GET) and unsafe (POST/DELETE) verbs on the same route.
rules.remediation_example: @app.route('/resource/<id>', methods=['POST'])  # restrict route exclusively to POST; reject method override headers

rules.name: HTTP parameter pollution across duplicate parameters
rules.description: Handler reads request query parameters without verifying multiplicity, allowing attackers to supply duplicate parameters to bypass WAFs or confuse backend parsers.
rules.remediation_example: val = request.args.getlist('param'); if len(val) > 1: raise BadRequest()  # reject ambiguous duplicate parameters

rules.name: Insecure client state reflection in hidden form fields
rules.description: HTML forms render client-supplied security parameters into hidden input fields without integrity validation or HMAC protection.
rules.remediation_example: <input type='hidden' name='token' value='{{ signed_state }}'>  # cryptographically sign hidden state
